title: Accessory Allocation and Consolidated Shipping Across Two Ostomy Supply Program Enrollments
content:
For a customer holding two Ostomy Supply Program enrollments, barriers and pouches are allowed per program, but the accessories counted per customer - paste (A4406), adhesive remover (A4455) and the ostomy belt (A4367) - are allowed once per customer.

**Which program carries the accessories.** Accessories ship only on the customer's ostomy program with the earlier enrolled date that is not closed, and the other program receives none. When that program closes, the remaining program carries them from its next refill.

**Consolidated shipping.** When the earliest permitted ship dates of the two programs fall within the tier's consolidation span in calendar days of each other, both refills ship together on the later of the two dates.

| Hypothetical case (consolidation span 10 days) | Result |
|---|---|
| Earliest permitted dates day 50 and day 58 | Both refills ship together on day 58 |
| Earliest permitted dates day 50 and day 65 | Not consolidated |
| Programs enrolled in January (colostomy) and June (urostomy), both open | Accessories ship on the colostomy program only |
| The January program closes | The June program carries the accessories from its next refill |
